title: DeepSeek V4 Pro (0813) now available as a Databricks-hosted model
body: Model Serving now supports [DeepSeek V4 Pro (0813)](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#deepseek-v4-pro-0813) as a Databricks-hosted model in the `us-west-2` region. This large mixture-of-experts language model supports reasoning and function calling for complex coding and agentic workflows. You can access this model using [Foundation Model APIs](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis).
